messages:
aditya: SSO failing for multiple users since ~11:12 UTC. App logs show `invalid_audience` and downstream role mapping returned empty -> users end up with no roles.

rachel: I pushed a small RBAC change this morning to role-map config (PR #554) that normalized audience from `api://redwood` -> `https://auth.redwood.com`. Could that be it?

jon: seeing additional errors in scim-provisioner logs: `kms.unwrap error=DecryptionFailure key=projects/keys/idp-attrs attempt=1`. Some JWE-encrypted attributes couldn't be unwrapped so role mapper received blank attrs and returned default empty-role.

aditya: so two issues: audience mismatch + KMS unwrap failures leading to dropped roles. Which happened first?

kms-bot: [audit] Key version rotation detected key=projects/keys/idp-attrs rotated_by=infra@redwood.com at=2025-05-02T09:03:02Z. Recent rewraps: 3 objects pending rewrap in vault path=secret/idp/encrypted-attrs.

rachel: I didn't touch KMS. My change only altered the mapping table. But if the attr blobs were rewrapped they might have new envelope keys and the provisioner hasn't reloaded them.

jon: confirmed: vault shows `secret/idp/encrypted-attrs/v1` encrypted with old key, and `.../v2` with new key. Provisioner pods read v1 at boot and haven't fetched v2. During request flow some requests hit pods mounted after a rolling deploy (reading v2) and some hit older pods (v1). When policy for audience changed, the role-map code validates aud claim AND decrypts the attribute blobs to compute group membership; with mixed decrypt capability we get inconsistent role assignment.

aditya: that mismatch causes users to occasionally end up with no roles or wrong roles. Any evidence of privilege escalation?

jon: no signs of escalation, but I did find one failed path where missing aud check would have fallen back to a permissive mapping if decrypt failed. That's a bug in role-mapper fallback.

rachel: immediate fix: revert the role-map change to previous audience and push a quick patch to make fallback conservative (deny on decrypt errors). Will open PRs.

aditya: also we should force rewrap of all dependent secrets and roll the provisioner so all instances see the same blob version.

jon: doing coordinated steps: 1) patch role-mapper to deny-on-decrypt-error (hotfix) 2) revert audience normalization in role-map config 3) run vault rewrap for secret/idp/encrypted-attrs -> v3 using current KMS alias 4) rollout provisioner with zero-downtime but ensuring all pods mount v3 before re-enable strict flow.

sre-bot: action: creating deployment window 11:40-12:00 UTC for scim-provisioner. Locking autoscaler.

jon: vault rewrap done, new path secret/idp/encrypted-attrs:v3 (rewrapped_at=2025-05-02T11:46:10Z). Triggered rolling restart of scim-provisioner with env refresh.

aditya: monitoring metrics: auth.success rate recovering, kms.unwrap errors dropped to 0. Auditing a sample of role assignments for 5m.

audit-bot: [audit] role-map.revert user=rachel pr=+554-revert at=2025-05-02T11:50:02Z. hotfix applied by jon pr=+561 deny-on-decrypt at=2025-05-02T11:52:08Z.

rachel: follow-ups: 1) add a pre-change integration test that validates audience values against deployed IdP JWTs 2) add a rewrap job triggered by KMS rotation to re-encrypt dependent Vault secrets automatically 3) change role-mapper fallback to explicit deny and add unit tests.

aditya: vuln triage: flagging as MEDIUM. Reason: role-mapper permissive fallback could have allowed missing-prod-aud to map to non-empty roles in edge case. No evidence exploited, but patch and controls required. Creating ticket SEC-2025-789.

jon: also adding infra guard: any change to role-mapping config requires at least one security approver and a canary rollout to 5% of auth traffic with monitoring of `role.assignment.churn` metric.

aditya: good. closing once PRs merged and rewrap job scheduled. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

rachel: I'll follow up with the PR links and test matrix in the ticket.

jon: leaving runbook note: on KMS rotation -> run `vault operator rewrap -prefix secret/idp/encrypted-attrs` and coordinate rolling restart of scim-provisioner.

sre-bot: monitor status: role.assignment.churn back to baseline. incident resolved.
